name: graph-alignment-benchmark-data
description: A dataset of paired graphs (synthetic and real-world) with ground-truth node correspondences intended to benchmark graph alignment and node-matching algorithms. It assesses robustness of alignment methods to structural perturbations, noise, and attribute changes across graphs. Useful for evaluating graph-matching, entity resolution, and network alignment approaches.
reputation: A specialized, research-oriented dataset hosted on Hugging Face that is used by a niche community working on graph alignment and matching.
